tools.name: get_master_data_schema
tools.description: Free discovery tool. Get supported public master-data entity types, identifiers, searchable attributes, relationships, reference domains, coverage, and freshness. Use this first when an agent does not know the data model or valid filters.

tools.name: search_master_data
tools.description: Paid x402 tool. Search trusted public master data for suppliers, locations, or organizations. Returns bounded golden-record summaries with match reasons, confidence, provenance, public-use status, freshness, and data-quality scores. Price ID: price.search.v1. Read masterdata://pricing before payment

tools.name: resolve_master_data_entity
tools.description: Paid x402 tool. Match incomplete or conflicting public supplier, location, or organization attributes to trusted master-data candidates. Returns explainable match evidence and never silently chooses an ambiguous entity. Price ID: price.resolve.v1.

tools.name: get_master_data_golden_record
tools.description: Paid x402 tool. Retrieve one authoritative public golden record by stable record ID. Returns public attributes, identifiers, source-record lineage, survivorship evidence, freshness, relationships summary, and data quality. Price ID: price.record.v1.

tools.name: get_master_data_relationships
tools.description: Paid x402 tool. Get governed public relationships for one master-data golden record, such as supplier ownership, location hierarchy, or organization parentage. Returns direction, validity dates, provenance, and confidence. Price IDs by requested depth: price.relationships.depth-1.v1, price.relations

tools.name: get_reference_data
tools.description: Paid x402 tool. Get governed public reference data and controlled vocabulary values such as country, currency, unit of measure, industry, status, category, or code mappings. Returns codes, labels, definitions, validity dates, mappings, provenance, and version. Price ID: price.reference.v1.

tools.name: assess_master_data_quality
tools.description: Paid x402 tool. Assess the completeness, validity, consistency, uniqueness, and freshness of a master-data record or supplied attributes. Returns explainable issues, severity, affected fields, policy rules, and safe remediation guidance without changing data. Price ID: price.quality.v1.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "resolve_master_data_entity" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.
